authority_note: GPT-Knowledge is a projection of verified repository/runtime evidence. Current repository source, local runtime evidence and acceptance results remain authoritative.

current_architecture.reasoning_owner: LiveAgentCore / provider remains responsible for strategy and tool choice.
current_architecture.runtime_owner: Runtime owns lifecycle, governed execution, evidence and terminal truth. At 741d208 it also contains a bounded deterministic duplicate-observation reconciliation guard, pending local regression proof.
current_architecture.key_gap: The Phase-1 no-progress guard is now source-implemented but has not yet been locally regression-proven on the current head.

proven_findings.detail: fcb533d preload normalization restored semantic execution.tool.started/execution.tool.completed delivery to the legacy renderer.
turn-37c41f6e450f190f repeatedly completed browserConversationRead without reaching terminal progress and later remained durable state executing.
At b2b6ff3, test/agent-runtime-no-progress-smoke.js expected second duplicate observation to block but runtime returned completed. This remains the proven pre-fix baseline.

741d208 modifies only src/agent/executive/LiveAgentCore.js (+53/-5): step-local observation fingerprinting, transient first-duplicate RUNTIME_NO_STATE_CHANGE notice, runtime.no_progress emission, and second-duplicate no_progress_stagnation interception before another provider completion.
browserSnapshot does not send raw HTML. It returns bounded visible text plus visible interactive nodes with temporary aa-N refs and metadata.

Browser navigation readiness currently relies on document.readyState interactive/complete. Non-navigation DOM click waits a fixed 100 ms before returning downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED; no network/mutation/hydration settlement contract is proven.
Managed Chrome launches with a reusable Access-owned --user-data-dir profile. This preserves transport login state but does not isolate general browsing state per task.

Current snapshot derives semantics from DOM selectors/aria-label/title/innerText/value/placeholder. Native Chromium Accessibility.getFullAXTree and screenshot dual perception are not current declared capabilities.
